webhooks.detail: Webhooks fire on system events (Actor run/build created, succeeded, failed, timed out, aborted, resurrected). Configurable in Console or via API, incl. ad-hoc webhooks per run.

evidence.quote: Webhooks allow you to configure the Apify platform to perform an action when a certain system event occurs.

sandbox.detail: Free plan with free usage credits; sign up free, no card. No separate sandbox, but free account works for integration testing.

evidence.quote: Enjoy $500 worth of free usage to build your own Actors and AI agents along with other benefits for 6 months.

rate_limits.summary: 250,000 req/min global per user; 60 req/sec per resource default (some endpoints higher); 429 on exceed

evidence.quote: The global rate limit is set to 250 000 requests per minute.
The Apify API client is the official library to access the Apify REST API from your JavaScript/TypeScript applications.
